title: Indefinite Integration
subject: Mathematics
subtitle: Class 12 HSC & MHT-CET • Rapid Revision Deck

cards.q: What is an Indefinite Integral and why add arbitrary constant c?
cards.a: Integration is the reverse process of differentiation (anti-derivative): ∫ f(x) dx = F(x) + c where F'(x) = f(x). 'c' is added because the derivative of any constant is zero.
cards.hint: Writing '+ c' is mandatory in every indefinite integral in HSC Board exams!

cards.q: Standard algebraic and exponential integrals?
cards.a:
∫ xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹ / (n + 1) + c  (n ≠ -1)
∫ (1/x) dx = ln|x| + c
∫ eˣ dx = eˣ + c
∫ aˣ dx = aˣ / ln a + c.
cards.hint: Trap: For n = -1, ∫ x⁻¹ dx = ln|x| + c, never apply power rule.

cards.q: Standard trigonometric integrals: sin, cos, sec², cosec²?
cards.a:
∫ sin x dx = -cos x + c
∫ cos x dx = sin x + c
∫ sec² x dx = tan x + c
∫ cosec² x dx = -cot x + c.
cards.hint: Trap: ∫ sin x dx has a MINUS sign (-cos x), unlike derivative of sin x.

cards.q: Integrals of sec x tan x and cosec x cot x?
cards.a:
∫ sec x tan x dx = sec x + c
∫ cosec x cot x dx = -cosec x + c.
cards.hint: Direct reverse of standard derivatives of sec x and cosec x.

cards.q: Integrals of tan x, cot x, sec x, and cosec x?
cards.a:
∫ tan x dx = ln|sec x| + c = -ln|cos x| + c
∫ cot x dx = ln|sin x| + c
∫ sec x dx = ln|sec x + tan x| + c = ln|tan(π/4 + x/2)| + c
∫ cosec x dx = ln|cosec x - cot x| + c = ln|tan(x/2)| + c.
cards.hint: Alternative half-angle forms ln|tan(π/4 + x/2)| and ln|tan(x/2)| are common CET options!

cards.q: Core substitution formulas for f'(x)?
cards.hint: Whenever numerator is the exact derivative of denominator, answer is ln|denominator|.

cards.q: Integrals of 1 / (x² + a²), 1 / (x² - a²), and 1 / (a² - x²)?
cards.hint: Mnemonic: (x² - a²) has (x - a) in numerator; (a² - x²) has (a + x) in numerator.

cards.q: Integrals of 1 / √(a² - x²), 1 / √(x² + a²), and 1 / √(x² - a²)?
cards.a:
∫ [1 / √(a² - x²)] dx = sin⁻¹(x/a) + c
∫ [1 / √(x² + a²)] dx = ln|x + √(x² + a²)| + c
∫ [1 / √(x² - a²)] dx = ln|x + √(x² - a²)| + c.
cards.hint: Notice: sin⁻¹(x/a) does NOT have 1/a outside, unlike tan⁻¹(x/a)!

cards.q: Three numerator square root formulas: √(a² - x²), √(x² + a²), √(x² - a²)?
cards.a:
∫ √(a² - x²) dx = (x/2)√(a² - x²) + (a²/2) sin⁻¹(x/a) + c
∫ √(x² + a²) dx = (x/2)√(x² + a²) + (a²/2) ln|x + √(x² + a²)| + c
∫ √(x² - a²) dx = (x/2)√(x² - a²) - (a²/2) ln|x + √(x² - a²)| + c.
cards.hint: Every formula starts with (x/2)(given root). Only √(x² - a²) has a MINUS sign before (a²/2).

cards.q: Formula for Integration by Parts and the LIATE rule?
cards.a:
∫ u v dx = u ∫ v dx - ∫ [ (du/dx) · ∫ v dx ] dx.
Priority order for choosing u: L (Logarithmic) → I (Inverse trig) → A (Algebraic) → T (Trigonometric) → E (Exponential).
cards.hint: Choose u as the function appearing earlier in LIATE, v as the second function.

cards.q: Classic Master Formula: ∫ eˣ [ f(x) + f'(x) ] dx?
cards.a: ∫ eˣ [ f(x) + f'(x) ] dx = eˣ · f(x) + c.
cards.hint: The single highest-frequency integration shortcut in MHT-CET! Spot f(x) and its derivative.

cards.q: Generalized Master Formula: ∫ e^(kx) [ k f(x) + f'(x) ] dx?
cards.a: ∫ e^(kx) [ k f(x) + f'(x) ] dx = e^(kx) · f(x) + c.
cards.hint: Look for the factor k multiplying f(x) matching the exponent coefficient.

cards.q: Formulas for ∫ e^(ax) sin(bx) dx and ∫ e^(ax) cos(bx) dx?
cards.a:
∫ e^(ax) sin(bx) dx = [ e^(ax) / (a² + b²) ] · [ a sin(bx) - b cos(bx) ] + c
∫ e^(ax) cos(bx) dx = [ e^(ax) / (a² + b²) ] · [ a cos(bx) + b sin(bx) ] + c.
cards.hint: Denominator is always (a² + b²). Sine integral has minus sign; cosine integral has plus sign.

cards.q: How to integrate 1 / (a sin² x + b cos² x + c)?
cards.a:
1. Divide numerator and denominator by cos² x.
2. In denominator, replace sec² x by (1 + tan² x).
3. Substitute tan x = t ⇒ sec² x dx = dt, reducing to 1 / (A t² + B).
cards.hint: Transforms trigonometric quadratic into standard algebraic integral in t.

cards.q: How to integrate (a sin x + b cos x) / (c sin x + d cos x)?
cards.a:
Express Numerator = A · (Denominator) + B · (d/dx Denominator).
Equate sin x and cos x coefficients to find A and B, then integral = A x + B ln|Denominator| + c.
cards.hint: Guaranteed 3-mark HSC Board template! First part integrates to A x, second to B ln|Denom|.

cards.q: How to integrate 1 / (a + b cos x) or 1 / (a + b sin x)?
cards.a: Use half-angle substitutions: put tan(x/2) = t ⇒ dx = 2 dt / (1 + t²), sin x = 2t / (1 + t²), cos x = (1 - t²) / (1 + t²).
cards.hint: (1 + t²) in denominators cancels cleanly, leaving a standard quadratic in t.

cards.q: Rules for Partial Fractions: Linear, Repeated, and Quadratic factors?
cards.a:
1. Distinct linear: 1 / ((x - a)(x - b)) = A/(x - a) + B/(x - b)
2. Repeated linear: 1 / (x - a)² = A/(x - a) + B/(x - a)²
3. Irreducible quadratic: 1 / ((x - a)(x² + bx + c)) = A/(x - a) + (Bx + C)/(x² + bx + c).
cards.hint: Always check: Degree of numerator MUST be strictly less than degree of denominator.

cards.q: TRAP: What must you do first if degree of numerator ≥ degree of denominator?
cards.a: You MUST perform polynomial long division first to express fraction as: Quotient + [ Remainder / Denominator ].
cards.hint: Applying partial fractions directly to improper fractions gives 100% wrong answers!

cards.q: Heaviside Cover-up Method for linear partial fractions?
cards.a: To find coefficient A of 1/(x - a), cover up the factor (x - a) in the original fraction and substitute x = a in the rest.
cards.hint: Finds all simple linear partial fraction coefficients in 5 seconds without writing systems of equations.

cards.q: Integral of (x² + 1) / (x⁴ + 1) and (x² - 1) / (x⁴ + 1)?
cards.a:
Divide numerator & denominator by x²:
1. (1 + 1/x²) / (x² + 1/x²) ⇒ put (x - 1/x) = t
2. (1 - 1/x²) / (x² + 1/x²) ⇒ put (x + 1/x) = t.

cards.q: Integral of √(tan x) or √(cot x)?
cards.a: Put tan x = t² ⇒ dx = 2t dt / (1 + t⁴), reducing to 2t² / (t⁴ + 1) = (t² + 1)/(t⁴ + 1) + (t² - 1)/(t⁴ + 1).
cards.hint: Splits into the two standard x⁴ + 1 symmetric forms above.

cards.q: Integral of form (px + q) / √(ax² + bx + c)?
cards.a:
Express numerator: px + q = A · d/dx(ax² + bx + c) + B = A(2ax + b) + B.
Integrates to: 2A √(ax² + bx + c) + B ∫ [ 1 / √(ax² + bx + c) ] dx.
cards.hint: First part uses ∫ f'(x)/√f(x) dx = 2√f(x); second completes the square.

cards.q: Integral of 1 / (x (xⁿ + 1))?
cards.a: Multiply and divide by xⁿ⁻¹: ∫ [ xⁿ⁻¹ / (xⁿ (xⁿ + 1)) ] dx. Put xⁿ = t ⇒ dt = n xⁿ⁻¹ dx, giving (1/n) ln|t / (t + 1)| + c = (1/n) ln|xⁿ / (xⁿ + 1)| + c.
cards.hint: Super-fast CET shortcut: ∫ 1 / [x (x⁷ + 1)] dx = (1/7) ln|x⁷ / (x⁷ + 1)| + c.

cards.q: Integral of 1 / (sin(x - a) cos(x - b))?
cards.a: Multiply and divide by cos(a - b), then write angle as (x - b) - (x - a) in numerator.
cards.hint: If both terms in denominator are same kind (sin·sin or cos·cos), divide by sin(a - b).

cards.q: MHT-CET differentiation verification trick for integration MCQs?
cards.a: Instead of evaluating complicated integrals, differentiate the 4 MCQ options using standard derivatives! The option whose derivative matches the integrand is correct.
cards.hint: Guaranteed lifesaver when you get stuck on a difficult integration substitution!
